## 🔥 Introduction

RedBench (also known as REDEdit-Bench) is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of current image editing models. 
Our main goal is to build more diverse scenarios and editing instructions that better align with human language. reputation: An emerging, curated benchmark for text-driven image editing that is gaining attention for evaluating fidelity and instruction alignment in editing models.
